rules.fix_hint: Add the scenario schedule or correct run_config.json.

rules.detail: Schedule file cannot be parsed (blocks/events malformed).
rules.fix_hint: Validate schedule structure and event formatting.

rules.detail: Schedule header missing or contains invalid run options.
rules.fix_hint: Use a valid DayCent schedule header.

rules.detail: Unable to determine run start/end years from schedule.
rules.fix_hint: Ensure schedule includes valid start year and events spanning the period.

rules.detail: Schedule references crop/cult/fert/etc. IDs not present in the selected library .100 files.
rules.fix_hint: Use valid IDs or upload matching library file override.

rules.detail: The schedule contains an event token outside the supported DayCent event vocabulary.
rules.fix_hint: Correct the event name or update the QC event policy if this is a valid new event.

rules.detail: Schedule event day-of-year must be 1 through 375; 366 is allowed.
Crop/tree start and end events are not paired in one of the supported families.
rules.fix_hint: Use valid pairings: FRST:LAST, PLTM:LAST, or TFST:TLST.

rules.detail: Weather files referenced by schedules must resolve inside the relative site directory.
rules.fix_hint: Place the weather file in sites/{site}/ and reference it by filename.

rules.detail: A schedule references a weather file that does not exist in the site directory.
rules.fix_hint: Add the weather file or correct the schedule reference.

rules.summary: Schedule site file violates naming convention
rules.detail: Schedule site-file references must use the site-level {site}_site.100 file, not a scenario-specific .100 file.
Scenarios under one site reference different weather files; this is currently discouraged.
rules.fix_hint: Use a consistent weather file per site unless intentionally using API-only alternative climate scenarios.

rules.detail: User .100 overrides are allowed only for known DayCent library files and the site-level {site}_site.100 file.
rules.fix_hint: Remove or rename the .100 file according to the upload contract.

rules.detail: A .100 library file contains duplicate block IDs.
rules.fix_hint: Ensure each block ID is unique within the library file.

rules.detail: The effective library set is missing a required DayCent .100 file.
rules.fix_hint: Provide the default library directory or upload the missing library file.
